# NTSB FOIA MU5735

This repository contains files originally shared by another GitHub user related to FOIA requests on the MU5735 investigation.

The original repository has since been deleted or made private by its owner. To protect their privacy, the files have been re-uploaded here without preserving the original commit history.

This repository serves as an archive to maintain access to those materials.

An unofficial Chinese translation of the NTSB recorder report is available at:
https://github.com/wrongly-cuddly-obsession/NTSB_FOIA_MU5735/blob/main/MU5735_NTSB_Recorder_Report_CN/MU5735_NTSB_Recorder_Report_Chinese.md

files.summary: This document is an unofficial Chinese translation of the National Transportation Safety Board's (NTSB) report on the cockpit voice recorder (CVR) and flight data recorder (FDR) recovery for a China Eastern Airlines Boeing 737-800 accident that occurred on March 21, 2022, in Wuzhou, China. The report details the formation of a joint investigation team by the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) and NTSB, the receipt and handling of the damaged CVR and FDR storage modules by NTSB personnel with CAAC supervision, and the systematic process of data recovery involving assessment

summary:
1. This project archives files related to Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests concerning the MU5735 investigation, which was previously unavailable due to the deletion or privatization of the original repository. It aims to ensure public access to these documents by maintaining them in a new, publicly accessible repository.

2. Individuals with interest in aviation accident investigations, transparency advocates, journalists, researchers, and any member of the public seeking information about the MU5735 incident would find value in using this repository.

3. The primary feature of this project is preserving and providing access to the archived files from the MU5735 investigation, including an unofficial Chinese translation of the NTSB recorder report. Its key capability lies in maintaining the availability of these documents for further analysis, study, and dissemination of information about the incident.
setupSteps: 1. Install Git on your local machine if you haven't already. You can download it from https://git-scm.com/.
2. Open your terminal or command prompt application.
3. Use the following command to clone the NTSB\_FOIA\_MU5735 repository: `git clone https://github.com/wrongly-cuddly-obsession/NTSB_FOIA_MU5735.git`
4. Navigate into the cloned repository directory using the command: `cd NTSB_FOIA_MU5735`
5. Explore the contents of the repository to familiarize yourself with the files and folders.

6. If you need to view the unofficial Chinese translation of the NTSB recorder report, open the file located at `MU5735_NTSB_Recorder_Report_CN/MU5735_NTSB_Recorder_Report_Chinese.md` in your web browser or a markdown viewer.
7. Remember that this repository serves as an archive to maintain access to the materials. You may want to periodically check back for updates or additional information.
